_help.about: Water has weight (design 30 Sept §BE): rivers carry a flow vector from the hydrology pass; the player drifts with it, cannot swim up a fast reach, is dragged wading, goes over falls. Rivers are one-way corridors. Restart after editing.
_help.flow: Speed bands per water kind in m/s; slope_gain and volume_gain shape the speed from the pass's slope and discharge.
_help.player: drift 1.0 = carried at the full current. upstream_wall_ratio: a current this share of swim speed or more is a wall (no headway). wade_drag: speed multiplier by depth. over_fall: what happens at a waterfall lip.
_help.waterfalls: check_first: Mike reports they may be broken; confirm they generate and render before touching the rest.
